**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 4.9(a), p0359).**

- **Section 7.4 Records; Inspection (p0481–p0482)** — acceptable as drafted: once per Calendar Year, one inspection per quarter's records, independent accounting firm reasonably acceptable to Ono, confidentiality agreement, Array's expense unless underpayment exceeds the stated threshold, no system access. Only the open-ended "reasonable prior written notice" falls short of the preferred 30-day figure, which is a minor sub-element noted rather than flagged.
- **Section 4.6(d)(ii) (p0340–p0343)** — cooperation on Regulatory Authority inspections, not a Vendor audit right; not flagged.
- **Section 4.9(a) (p0359)** — unlimited-frequency on-site entry into our facilities on merely "reasonable advance notice," with mandatory assistance and no cost allocation. This fails the fallback and edges into walk-away territory, so we added a once-per-Calendar-Year cap, 30 days' prior written notice and Array's cost, keeping a narrow for-cause follow-up carve-out and preserving on-site access given the GxP context.
